verdict.rationale: Zulip documents an interactive bot framework for bots that react to messages, lets you write and run custom bots, and offers the Zulip Botserver for production deployment. An AI agent that responds in channels could therefore be built on this, but the user would have to write and host the agent themselves. Missing for 10: any first-party or turnkey AI-agent integration, documentation of adding a bot as a channel member, documentation of mention-triggered responses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
